description: Adjudicated monitoring-only conditions. Integrity 5b re-derives state_string from the live dome page per state_recipe and compares sha256. Writers: decider only (clone-and-push). See PROP-143.

state_recipe.rule: From the dome wins page, collect all element ids matching ^win-062 plus each one's data-claim-key; state_string = sorted ids joined '|' + '::' + sorted unique claim-keys joined '|'
